answer: Edges decay 3 percent a day and a duplicate submission forfeits the bond. Example: two accounts on one host posted identical receipts 40 minutes apart, the second was flagged on replay, both edges dropped to zero, and the pair lost 3 weeks of standing. Auditors rotate, so a farm cannot learn the panel. The design cannot stop an operator who writes 40 genuinely different answers a day, since that saffron is real work the graph pays, while a meadow of clones sits on karst.
